opus_prompt.instruction:
Perform a deep, critical analysis of the codebase within the target directory. Read all relevant files to understand the current architecture and implementation details.
All suggestions and plans must be evaluated strictly on their potential to improve: 1. Performance 2. Quality of the resulting output/feature 3. Technical Soundness and Long-Term Maintainability (Complexity and implementation time are secondary; prioritize the technically superior solution even if it is complex or time-consuming).
Ignore factors related to infrastructure cost or other non-essential business overhead unless directly impacting the above three points.

analysisPoints.point: Identify and document the primary project weaknesses.
Pinpoint current performance or architectural bottlenecks.
List any current functional or technical gaps.
Suggest specific areas for code or process optimization.
Propose at least one significant new feature or architectural enhancement based on the latest relevant technologies, deriving ideas directly from codebase analysis.

deliverable.details: Create a structured Product Requirements Document (PRD) plan outlining the prioritized recommendations from the analysis. The plan must include: 1. Problem Statement (for each suggested improvement/feature). 2. Proposed Solution / New Feature Description. 3. Technical Implementation Outline (high-level steps). 4. Estimated Priority (Critical, High, Medium, Low).

opus_prompt.thinkingMode: Actively scan the codebase for novel opportunities for innovation that were not explicitly requested, prioritizing modern, efficient, and scalable solutions.
